# Akoma 87.9 FM on Facebook: "NAIMOS and the Ghana Navy have arrested 27 suspected illegal miners, including a Chinese national, d…"

NAIMOS and the Ghana Navy have arrested 27 suspected illegal miners, including a Chinese national, during a dawn raid at Anyinamso No. 2 in the Ashanti Region.

Two armed men guarding the site were disarmed, and their pump-action guns retrieved without incident.
